# American Film Institute

> > AFI is America's leading nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing and preserving the art of film, television and digital media through education, festivals, honors and cultural programming.

The American Film Institute operates the AFI Conservatory graduate film school, presents major film festivals including AFI FEST and AFI DOCS, and honors industry legends through programs like the AFI Life Achievement Award. AFI champions independent filmmakers, supports documentary storytelling, and celebrates cinema through partnerships with cultural institutions worldwide.
